item.title: Powered by women, ‘Wuthering Heights’ digs up $34.8 million at the box office for a No. 1 debut
item.description: Emerald Fennell's new "Wuthering Heights" has opened in first place at the North American box office. Studio estimates on Sunday say it made $34.8 million in its first three days.

item.title: TEMA urges TN residents to prepare for spring severe weather
item.description: As Tennessee approaches the spring severe weather season, the Tennessee Emergency Management Agency (TEMA) is partnering with the National Weather Service (NWS) to raise awareness about the growing risks posed by severe weather and to encourage Tennesseans to take action before storms strike.

item.title: FBI: DNA recovered from glove found near Guthrie home that appears to match glove worn by suspect
item.description: A glove containing DNA found about two miles from the house of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's mother appears to match those worn by a masked person outside her front door in Tucson the night she vanished, the FBI said Sunday.

item.title: BMS Basketball team wins its first-ever TSAA State Championship title
item.description: BOLIVAR, Tenn.—The Bolivar Middle School basketball team made history Saturday at the State Championship games. Credit: Bolivar Middle School After defeating Humboldt, the team traveled to Smyrna, TN to take on Summertown. The team of talented young players took home the title, making them the first-ever TSAA State Championship Winners for Bolivar Middle School. Categories: Local News, News, Sports
